pullRequest.body:
The MIM SSSOM builder can publish another record’s preferred name as an alias. This applies the owned-name export policy approved in [MIM #669](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/669#issuecomment-6558035777) before alias capping and on late CAS/registry paths. Ownership comes from the complete mapped-record snapshot, including explicit tombstone representatives. Source YAML and scientific identity decisions are preserved.

Closes #701. Closes #702. Closes #703. Closes #704. Closes #705. Closes #706. Closes #707. Closes #708.

Each generation writes the diagnostic SSSOM, one suppression sidecar row per subject/token pair, and a manifest binding inputs, captured producer sources, resolved labels and output hashes. Native locking and validated transactions retain recovery journals. Path aliases, changed inputs/outputs, incomplete journals and nonzero validator exits fail. The legacy TSV-only publisher refuses policy-marked candidates. Declared local producer dependencies execute from captured source bytes; the documented trusted source-entrypoint/caller boundary remains. This is a process drift guard, not cryptographic attestation.

The fresh run at producer `90d110e663c10146351b09ae98d387dabdec0b1c` generated **2,974 rows**: 2,728 exact, 150 broad and 96 close matches. Its 25 suppression events aggregate into 20 unique sidecar pairs: seven remove tokens present in the previous diagnostic; 13 were already excluded as dedicated object labels. All mapped YAML and comparison inputs stayed byte-identical. CultureMech outputs and Mediadive nodes were comparison inputs, not bulk imports. Four observed ENVO label-resolution differences remain diagnostic and are outside canonical promotion.

Validation is bound in the [portable evidence package](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/culturebotai-claw/blob/1f5ad6779cdb3f39f39ba6f9f26d31840b7e7077/reports/mim_owned_name_export_20261101/README.md):

- Exact candidate/sidecar replay, schema checks and native invariants passed with **zero rejects**, including Rule K with an empty in-memory baseline. B4 passed for available transforms; BTO (1 row) and MICRO (73 rows) follow the native missing-transform warning/skip contract. No missing transform was invented.
- Full local suite at `a56f3ae4563619a5129ad944878c9205267315d6`: **6,660 passed, 390 skipped**, 16 warnings, **87.19% coverage**. Separate safety-module coverage: **76%**, passing its 60% gate. Ruff, maintained mypy (56 files), README/CI parity and configuration checks passed.
- MIM canary `just qc` passed at merged `be7170deb00a7c5490f8ade82facf86d45a852a4`, using its separate pinned native validator. Existing scientific-release blockers remain; this PR grants no scientific approval.
- Independent source and packaging repair reviews passed, with original failures, fixes and fresh mutation controls preserved. The #708 packager repair binds frozen plans and README content to the reviewed selection. The committed package verifies all 466 members and 572 original evidence identities. Exact final-head review is required before queue admission.
- Earlier interrupted runs, the corrected README parity failure, the process-sandbox failure and successful authorized rerun, and the overstrict v3 acceptance precondition are retained with their actual outcomes. The final commit adds only the evidence package to the tested source head.

The bounded MIM consumer PR follows this prerequisite: approved immediate alias decisions, [MIM #1019](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1019) and [#1020](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1020), a separate canonical sidecar and native receipts. It will preserve the 23 pairs deferred until the [MIM #912 replacement](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/pull/912). This PR changes no MIM canonical products, protected workflow/pin, goal, cycle, live session or shared Claw checkout. No paid provider calls were made. No supervisor binding is assigned. All PR checks and the one-at-a-time native squash queue must pass before merge; landed content and owned-branch cleanup are then verified.
